subject: gbrain
tagline: Your AI agent is smart but forgetful. GBrain gives it a brain — hybrid RAG + self-wiring knowledge graph for agent platforms

modules.name: src/core
modules.description: Contract-first operations, pluggable engine interface, PGLite + Postgres engines, hybrid search, chunkers, embeddings

modules.name: src/commands
modules.description: 34 CLI command implementations (init, import, sync, query, eval, jobs, doctor, orphans, repair-jsonb, extract, etc)

modules.name: src/mcp
modules.description: MCP stdio server (41 operations generated from contract)

modules.name: src/core/minions
modules.description: Postgres-native durable job queue (BullMQ-inspired): queue, worker, attachments, cascade-kill

modules.name: skills
modules.description: 26 skills organized by RESOLVER.md (signal-detector, brain-ops, ingest, query, maintain, enrich, minion-orchestrator, etc)

modules.name: recipes
modules.description: 7 integration recipes (calendar, credential-gateway, email, meeting-sync, ngrok, twilio-voice, x-to-brain)

modules.name: docs
modules.description: MCP deploy guides, benchmarks, architecture, ethos, guides, designs

capabilities.name: Hybrid search (vector + keyword + RRF)
capabilities.description: Vector + keyword + RRF + multi-query expansion + dedup; intent classifier auto-selects detail level

capabilities.name: Self-wiring knowledge graph (zero-LLM auto-link)
capabilities.description: Every page write extracts entity refs and creates typed links (attended/works_at/invested_in/founded/advises/source/mentions) with zero LLM calls; traversal queries

capabilities.name: Pluggable engines (PGLite / Postgres)
capabilities.description: PGLite (embedded, zero-config, 2-second init) OR Postgres+pgvector (Supabase / self-hosted); bidirectional migration

capabilities.name: Contract-first operations (~41 shared)
capabilities.description: Single source truth; CLI and MCP both generated from it; 1137-line operations file

capabilities.name: Minions durable job queue (Postgres-native)
capabilities.description: BullMQ-inspired: submit/claim/complete, stall detection, parent-child, depth/child-cap, timeouts, cascade-kill, attachments, idempotency keys

capabilities.name: Tiered enrichment (Tier 1/2/3 auto-escalation)
capabilities.description: Stub page → web+social → full pipeline based on mention frequency and context

capabilities.name: MCP stdio + remote HTTP
capabilities.description: 30+ MCP tools via stdio; remote HTTP with token auth via ngrok

capabilities.name: Retrieval eval harness
capabilities.description: P@k, R@k, MRR, nDCG@k; single-run + A/B config comparison; published BrainBench v1 (R@5 83%→95%, graph-only F1 86.6% vs grep 57.8%)

capabilities.name: Trust-boundary-aware ops (remote flag)
capabilities.description: OperationContext.remote distinguishes trusted local CLI vs untrusted agent-facing callers; tightens filesystem confinement for uploads

capabilities.name: 26 bundled skills (agent workflows)
capabilities.description: Fat markdown skills; resolver routes; skill-creator for conformance

capabilities.name: 7 integration recipes
capabilities.description: YAML+markdown recipes for external events (Twilio voice, email, X, calendar, meetings)

capabilities.name: 4-tier identity + access (SOUL/USER/ACCESS/HEARTBEAT)
capabilities.description: 6-phase interview generating SOUL.md (agent identity), USER.md (user profile), ACCESS_POLICY.md (4-tier privacy), HEARTBEAT.md (cadence)

capabilities.name: Publish (password-protected HTML, zero LLM)
capabilities.description: Share brain pages as password-protected HTML; deterministic, zero LLM calls

capabilities.name: Universal migration (Obsidian/Notion/Logseq/Roam/CSV/JSON/MD)
capabilities.description: Universal import from common note-taking formats

capabilities.name: Doctor + reliability checks
capabilities.description: jsonb_integrity + markdown_body_completeness + data checks; fix hints to repair-jsonb and sync --force

quality_signals.test_framework: bun test + E2E (pytest-style with real Postgres)

skills.mechanism: Fat markdown skills in skills/; RESOLVER.md routing; skill-creator with conformance tests

recipes.mechanism: YAML frontmatter + markdown in recipes/; trust-tagged sources

engines.mechanism: src/core/engine.ts interface; pluggable PGLite or Postgres

mcp.note: MCP server is a primary surface (30+ tools, stdio + HTTP)

plugin_handlers.mechanism: Host-specific handlers registered via plugin contract; migration emits TODOs to pending-host-work.jsonl

unique_selling_points: Self-wiring knowledge graph with zero-LLM auto-link on every write
Hybrid RAG (vector + keyword + RRF + multi-query expansion) with published benchmark (R@5 83%→95%)
Pluggable engines: PGLite (zero-config, 2s init) or Postgres+pgvector (Supabase)
Contract-first: 41 operations generate both CLI and MCP server from single source
Minions: durable Postgres-native job queue built into the brain
Trust boundary: remote flag distinguishes trusted CLI vs untrusted agent callers
Installed by an agent in ~30 minutes (agent-driven install)
Designed to run under OpenClaw and Hermes (not a standalone assistant)

limitations.description: Not a standalone assistant — designed as a brain layer under an agent platform (OpenClaw or Hermes recommended)
No built-in messaging channels (channels come from host platform)
MCP remote HTTP requires manual ngrok + token setup (not a hosted service)
ChatGPT MCP requires OAuth 2.1 (not yet implemented)
